description: G0b plan-fidelity gate fires on PostToolUse(Edit|Write|Bash|NotebookEdit) when an unpaired plan_approved exists in the journal. Per-action gate, not per-phase — schema uses `expected_state` instead of `expected_phase` (see evals/README.md for divergence rationale).

should_trigger.prompt: Write a new test spec at protocol-testing/quic/quic_test_handshake.ivy
Apply the diff from the plan's first task to bgp_frame.ivy
Run the first scaffold step from the approved plan

should_not_trigger.prompt: Edit any file (no plan_approved in journal — plan-mode active)
Read the BGP speaker spec to understand it
Edit a second file after G0b already ran (cycle closed)
Edit a file 30 minutes into a G0b cycle (in flight)
List files in the protocol-testing directory
